title: Reviewing @Bose’s Meta ads. What would you rate this?
description: Reviewing @Bose’s Meta ads. What would you rate this?
transcript: Let's make my favourite Grilled Peach and burrata summer salad inspired by Bose's Soundlink Flex in Sunset Peach. Okay, this is an ad for Bose. Why is she talking about making a salad? I picked up a variety. This entire ad is some lady showing us how to make a salad. How is that selling music products? Who would Bose approve this? 0 out of ten.
